title: Una crisis que transformó la región
goal: Read a closing synthesis of why 1929 counts as a genuine turning point -- proving the export model's limits, opening space for new political leadership, and cementing import substitution as the region's new economic norm.

items: Explain why many historians consider 1929 a turning point.
State whether the export model disappeared immediately after the crisis.
Explain what political space opened up because of the crisis.
Describe what import substitution industrialization became in the following decades.
Use de ahí que + subjunctive to draw a conclusion from evidence already presented.
